evals.name: one-bug-per-report
evals.prompt: You found two different defects in one run.
evals.expected_output: Files two reports. Does NOT combine them.

evals.name: out-of-scope-is-separate
evals.prompt: During QA of #220 you find a bug in a command the PR did not touch.
evals.expected_output: Files it as a separate bug (`fsd-qa bug`) and keeps the PR verdict on its own acceptance. Never fails the PR for it.
